hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233810 (notice 'No electric hookups at this facility') + catalog 233810 (every site STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-28

values.note: FS: 16 sites in one large loop (7 paved pull-throughs, 9 gravel dead-end spurs), the host usually in site 16. recreation.gov lists 15: 14 RV sites (8 reservable, 6 first-come) and tent-only site 007. FS: 'Maximum trailer length is 40 feet'; 'Maximum spur length is 40 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' Up to 8 people and 2 vehicles per site; open meadow with little shade or screening from CO-149.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/marshall-park-campground ('16 sites arranged in a large loop, of which 7 are paved pull through sites and 9 are dead end gravel spurs'; 'Campground hosts are usually stationed here in site 16'; 'Maximum trailer length is 40 feet') + recreation.gov catalog 233810 (001-015: 14 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, 1 TENT ONLY; reservable flags; Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233810 (notice: max 8 people, 2 vehicles per site), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No drinking water (bring your own); a sink-water disposal facility; trash Memorial Day-Labor Day; firewood from the host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/marshall-park-campground ('There is a vault toilet. There is no potable water'; 'There is a sink water disposal facility'; 'Firewood may be purchased through the campground host') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233810 (notice 'No drinking water available; please bring your own supply'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend (FS); 2026 concessionaire operations began May 22.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/marshall-park-campground ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend'; 'Concessionaire operations for 2026 season begin May 22nd'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 10 sites reservable (recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777) at least 4 days ahead and up to 6 months out; 6 first-come. Weekend 2-night and holiday-weekend 3-night minimums on recreation.gov. A reserved site is held until check-out time the day after arrival. 2026 reservation season May 22-Sep 7 (2027: May 28-Sep 6). Tends to be full mid-June through August.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/marshall-park-campground ('Reservations must be made at least 4 days ahead of arrival and can be made up to 6 months in advance'; 'Of the 16 campsites: 10 are reservable, 6 are first come, first served'; '14-day camping limit'; 'It tends to be full from mid-June through August') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233810 (rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 / rolling 30 days, reservationCutOff 4) + /rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 a site (6 people, 1 vehicle) in 2026 and 2027; $10 a night per extra person (max 8) or second vehicle, paid at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233810/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/marshall-park-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night') + recreation.gov notice on extra people/vehicles, read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off single campsites only, for the site the pass holder occupies.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/marshall-park-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY'), read 2026-10-28

note: Rio Grande NF, ~7 mi SW of Creede off Hwy 149 (FR 523) at ~8,800 ft, the closest forest campground to Creede: an open meadow between the highway and the Rio Grande, with views of Bristol Head; highway traffic is visible and audible. Paved loop, passenger-car access; ADA fishing access with a boat launch. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov: confirmed vault toilet, no water, no hookups (rec.gov 'No electric hookups'), $26 (2026), part reservable on recreation.gov; added max 40 ft, booking window/cutoff/min stays/14-night limit/booking.season 05-22 to 09-07, season note, senior-pass discount; site count 16 -> 15 (public sites; site 16 is the host's). Note trimmed of field facts and the outdated reservable/FCFS split.
flags: Missing phone: Divide Ranger District (719) 657-3321 (FS page contact). recreation.gov lists the concessionaire (PMC, customerservice@pmcparks.com) at 719-658-0829, and (805) 434-1996 for facility information.

Reservable split: the old note said sites 1-10 reservable and 11-17 first-come; the catalog has 001-003, 005-010 reservable (with 007 tent-only) and 004, 011-015 first-come. FS says 10 reservable + 6 first-come of 16.
Length conflict: FS 'Maximum trailer length is 40 feet' / 'Maximum spur length is 40 feet'; the catalog's per-site lengths run 40-103 ft (pull-throughs 56-103). Recorded the FS 40.
recreation.gov's amenity list includes 'Drinking Water', against its own notice and FS ('no potable water'). Recorded no potable water.

Waterfront: stored riverfront looks supported. On imagery with catalog site points, the loop's east and south sides (010-013, 004-006) sit ~30-50 m from the Rio Grande with open meadow and a thin line of trees between; the west side faces CO-149 across open ground. Left as is.
Status: FS banner 'Site Open'; past its season. The Rio Grande NF's October 22-23, 2026 flood-damage list names no road near Creede/CO-149.
Pin 37.79085,-106.98172 is ~96 m north of the catalog site centroid (37.78999,-106.98163) and ~55 m from the FS coordinate (37.7903648,-106.9816077). OK.
